name: TextMetrics
brief: Describes the font metrics of a text object.
description: Provides the basic vertical layout metrics used for text rendering, such as ascent, descent, and line spacing (linegap).

members.name: ascent
members.brief: Distance from the baseline to the top of the highest glyph (usually positive).

members.name: descent
members.brief: Distance from the baseline to the bottom of the lowest glyph (usually negative, as in TTF).

members.name: advance
members.brief: The total vertical advance between lines of text: ascent - descent + linegap (i.e., ascent + |descent| + linegap when descent is negative).
